headline: Argentina Offers Short-Term Peso Debt to Cover Upcoming Maturities
summary: The Argentine government offered short-term peso debt to roll over upcoming maturities, pausing long-term issuance due to pricing and market uncertainty ahead of a $10.6 trillion commitment.
why: Sovereign debt auctions and rollover operations determine local debt sustainability, short-term interest rates, and liquidity conditions in domestic capital markets.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Managing short-term debt rollovers affects sovereign yield curves.
